item.title: Liam Ohgren gets only goal in seven-round shootout as Canucks rally past Bruins 5-4
item.description: BOSTON (AP) — Liam Ohgren was the only one to score in a seven-round shootout, and the Vancouver Canucks beat the Boston Bruins 5-4 on Saturday night for their fourth straight victory.

item.title: Fowler posts first shutout in 4-0 win, Canadiens hand Penguins eighth straight loss
item.description: MONTREAL — Jacob Fowler made 31 saves for his first shutout in his fourth career start as the Montreal Canadiens rolled over the slumping Pittsburgh Penguins 4-0 in the first game of a home-and-home series on Saturday night.

item.title: NHL roundup: Red Wings stay hot, roll past Capitals 5-2 to maintain Atlantic lead
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Moritz Seider had a goal and an assist and the Detroit Red Wings beat the Washington Capitals 5-2 on Saturday.

item.title: Australia retains the Ashes with 2 tests to spare after a tense victory over England in Adelaide
item.description: ADELAIDE, Australia (AP) — Australia retained the Ashes with two tests to spare after paceman Mitchell Starc took three of the last four wickets to blunt England's defiant comeback in the third cricket test.

item.title: Goalie Carter Hart to start for Vegas Golden Knights in Edmonton against Oilers
item.description: CALGARY — Vegas Golden Knights goaltender Carter Hart will be the first of five former Canadian junior hockey players acquitted of sexual assault earlier this year to appear in a professional game in Canada. Hart, from Sherwood Park, Alta.

item.title: Schwaller to play Whyte, Fujisawa to face Tirinzoni in Grand Slam finals
item.description: SASKATOON — Yannick Schwaller of Geneva, Switzerland, punched his ticket to Sunday's final at the HearingLife Canadian Open with a 7-5 win Saturday night over John Shuster of Duluth, Minn.

item.title: Sweden rallies to knock off Canada 4-2 in world junior tournament tune-up
item.description: LONDON — Jack Berglund scored twice in the third period, including a short-handed marker 43 seconds into the frame, as Sweden rallied to beat Canada 4-2 in a pre-World Junior Hockey Championship contest on Saturday night.

item.title: Bowen Yang will depart 'SNL' after Christmas episode hosted by Ariana Grande
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Bowen Yang, coming off a huge year or two of projects , is departing “SNL” mid-season after Saturday's episode hosted by his “Wicked” buddy Ariana Grande.

item.title: Backlund scores twice, Calgary Flames beat Vegas Golden Knights 6-3
item.description: CALGARY — Mikael Backlund scored twice to spur the Calgary Flames to a 6-3 win over the visiting Vegas Golden Knights on Saturday.

item.title: Tearful Bowen Yang departs 'SNL' after emotional Christmas episode hosted by Ariana Grande
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Bowen Yang bid an emotional farewell to “Saturday Night Live” with music, laughter and help from his “Wicked” buddy Ariana Grande .
